Method of Attack: Mining Trojan that injects into legitimate attrib.exe process to utilize high CPU for mining
Terminates miner processes when popular game or process manager processes are detected to avoid detection
Creates scheduled task 'WindowsRecoveryCleaner' to run miner every minute starting at midnight
Miner polls running processes and terminates itself if blacklisted processes (games or utilities) are detected, then restarts shortly after
Impacted Systems: Popular games: PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds (PUBG), Counterstrike: Global Offensive (csgo.exe), Rainbow Six (RainbowSix.exe), Dota 2 (dota2.exe), TslGame.exe
Process management utilities: Task Manager (taskmgr.exe), Process Explorer (procexp.exe), Process Monitor (procmon.exe), Process Hacker (ProcessHacker.exe), AnVir Task Manager (anvir.exe)
Indicators of Compromise: Scheduled task command: schtasks /create /tn WindowsRecoveryCleaner /tr "C:\ProgramData\Iostream.exe" /st 00:00 /sc daily /du 9999:59 /ri 1 /f
